items.name: Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps
items.one_liner: Open-source collection of AI agents & RAG apps
items.pain_point: Enterprises struggle to implement and scale AI agents; lack of ready-to-use, open-source options
app_ideas: AI Agent Marketplace: Curated, searchable directory of open-source agents with easy integration
AI Agent Orchestrator: Tool to manage, monitor, and optimize multiple AI agents in a single interface
items.monetization: B2B API wrapper with premium support, customization, and enterprise-grade features
items.why_now: Growing interest in AI agents and RAG, increasing demand for open-source solutions

items.name: deanpeters/Product-Manager-Skills
items.one_liner: A product management skills framework for AI coding agents.
items.pain_point: AI agents make poor product decisions without structured PM methods; product teams and AI tool builders would pay for reliable guidance.
app_ideas: A PM copilot CLI that injects battle-tested PM frameworks into Claude Code/Codex workflows for discovery and prioritization
A marketplace of skill packs (user research, roadmap, metrics) that agents load on-demand
An eval harness that scores agent PM outputs against the framework to benchmark and improve
items.monetization: Freemium: free core framework, paid premium skill packs and team analytics
items.why_now: AI coding agents are exploding but lack domain-specific PM playbooks, leaving a clear whitespace for structured skill frameworks.

items.name: nguyenlevel/product-manager-skills
items.one_liner: Product management framework for AI agents
items.pain_point: Helps product managers and teams build AI agents efficiently, saving time and resources
app_ideas: AI agent training and deployment platform
items.monetization: Freemium with enterprise pricing for advanced features
items.why_now: Increased demand for AI agents and automation tools

items.name: github/spec-kit
items.one_liner: Toolkit for adopting Spec-Driven Development or custom workflows
items.pain_point: Engineering teams struggle to enforce structured specs; adopters need tooling to define, track, and validate specs. Payers: dev tooling buyers, engineering leads, consultancies.
app_ideas: Spec-to-PR bot that checks code diffs against spec requirements and flags gaps
Spec-to-issue generator that breaks specs into actionable GitHub/Jira tasks with acceptance criteria
Spec coverage dashboard that visualizes which features have specs and tracks drift across repos
items.monetization: B2B SaaS freemium: free for solo devs, paid team plans with workflow automation and analytics
items.why_now: AI accelerates spec writing, but process enforcement tooling remains fragmented—ripe for a focused vertical solution
